# statusdrift_status_page (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_status_page" "public" {
  name        = "Service Status"
  type        = "all"
  enabled     = true
  description = "Current status of all services"

  show_announcements = true
  show_incidents     = true
  show_history       = true
  history_days       = 90
  show_uptime        = true
  show_response_time = true
  show_overall_status = true

  color_theme  = "light"
  timezone     = "America/New_York"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the status page.
- `type` (String) The type of status page. Valid values: all, monitor, group, tag, custom.

### Optional

- `color_theme` (String) The color theme. Valid values: light, dark.
- `custom_css` (String) Custom CSS for the status page.
- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain for the status page.
- `description` (String) A description of the status page.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the status page is enabled.
- `favicon_url` (String) URL of the favicon for the status page.
- `google_analytics_id` (String) Google Analytics measurement ID (e.g. 'G-XXXXXXXXXX').
- `hide_powered_by` (Boolean) Whether to hide the 'Powered by StatusDrift' branding.
- `history_days` (Number) The number of days of history to display (1-365).
- `incident_display_types` (List of String) List of incident types to display. Valid values: all, down, warning, manual.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the logo to display on the status page.
- `monitor_group_id` (Number) The monitor group ID. Required when type is 'group'.
- `monitor_id` (Number) The monitor ID. Required when type is 'monitor'.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to protect the status page.
- `primary_color` (String) Primary color in hex format (e.g. '#FF5733').
- `show_announcements` (Boolean) Whether to show announcements on the status page.
- `show_history` (Boolean) Whether to show history on the status page.
- `show_incidents` (Boolean) Whether to show incidents on the status page.
- `show_overall_status` (Boolean) Whether to show overall status on the status page.
- `show_response_time` (Boolean) Whether to show response time on the status page.
- `show_uptime` (Boolean) Whether to show uptime percentage on the status page.
- `social_links` (Block List) Social media links to display on the status page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--social_links))
- `tag_id` (Number) The tag ID. Required when type is 'tag'.
- `timezone` (String) The timezone for the status page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the status page.
- `slug` (String) The URL slug of the status page.

<a id="nestedblock--social_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `social_links`

Required:

- `platform` (String) The social media platform. Valid values: twitter, facebook, linkedin, github, instagram, youtube, discord, slack.
- `url` (String) The URL of the social media profile or page.
